rationale: Setup at ss 100C 1.60V max-RC is the only binding limit: hold +0.08-0.09 ns with no hold buffers, final DRC 0, slew/cap 0 vs bar 309. All six round runs at 7.02 ns are port-path-limited (+0.63-0.70 ns, beyond the 0.4 ns margins), so keep period_frac at its floor and both margins maxed (PL 0.4 beat 0.3). Utilisation is the clearest signal: util 20 gave the best port slack (+0.703, T_eff 6.317) and the cleanest routing (DRC [11,0,50,0]); util 49 gave +0.626-0.648 and the weakest reg-to-reg (+0.739). Low util also leaves room for repair buffers in the tighter re-runs. Pin util 20, drop the cap-40 pin (no gain); keep AREA 3, cap213, post-GRT timing, slew 40.
